answer: A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The tundra schedule is applied in ripple and nadir shows each instalment. A payout is split and hence 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1332 identities would post 3673 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
